topic: The 24-hour impulse-buy rule vs instant checkout (Boone vs Ingrid)

scenes.narration: One simple waiting rule saved her over two thousand dollars in regret buys. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a big stopwatch labeled TWENTY FOUR HOURS, comic burst banner reads WAIT FIRST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Boone and Ingrid both scroll the same shopping apps nightly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man boone and woman ingrid both scrolling phones on couches, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both see the same flashy ads and limited time deals.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two phone screens crowded with ads stamped SALE and LIMITED TIME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Boone taps buy now the second something catches his eye.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, boone smashing a glowing BUY NOW button on his phone, comic banner reads INSTANT CHECKOUT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Boxes pile by his door, half of them never opened.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a tall stack of unopened delivery boxes by boone's front door, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ingrid puts every want in the cart and waits one day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ingrid setting a phone down beside a stopwatch reading TWENTY FOUR HOURS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tomorrow she asks if she still actually wants it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ingrid the next morning looking at her cart, a thought bubble reading DO I STILL WANT THIS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Most days the urge is gone and she deletes the cart.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ingrid dragging cart items into a trash can icon stamped DELETED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Boone's closet is stuffed with unused stuff.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, boone opening a closet overflowing with tagged unused items, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ingrid kept two thousand dollars she would have impulse spent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ingrid smiling beside a savings jar reading TWO THOUSAND SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She still bought the things she genuinely wanted, just slower.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, ingrid happily holding one chosen item, a checkmark stamped WORTH IT beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wait twenty four hours before any want purchase. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading TWENTY FOUR HOUR RULE, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
